results.title: East China refunds: company-wide summary (Q3)
results.content: Refunds in East China rose noticeably in Q3, mainly from mid-September, while North China and South China stayed in their normal range (b-101, b-103). Customer complaints point mostly to payment problems at checkout, such as being charged twice, and an app payment update around Sep 12 is a possible factor, but the cause is not confirmed and one source (b-318) is still unverified. Customers can request refunds within 30 days from the Orders page, with money returned in 5-7 business days (b-208). Exact figures and detailed findings are kept in restricted blocks (b-101, b-207).
